Class IndexEntry

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.IndexEntry
public class IndexEntry extends Object
The IndexEntry is one index row copied onto the heap. The off-heap index remains the store. This object is the copy a caller reads. The object stores the message id, which is the number that locates the frame. The object stores the page id, the frame offset, and the frame length. The object stores the token count, the time, the role byte, and the type byte. The object stores the flags. The object stores the RouxId. The identity may be null. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#IndexEntry roux-v1.md

  • Constructor Details

    • IndexEntry

      public IndexEntry(long messageId, int pageId, int offset, int length, int tokenCount, long timestamp, byte role, byte type, short flags, RouxId rouxId)
      The constructor stores one index row on the heap.
      Parameters:
      messageId - The message id is the number that locates the frame.
      pageId - The page id is the page that holds the frame.
      offset - The offset is the first byte of the frame in that page.
      length - The length is the frame size in bytes.
      tokenCount - The token count is the number stored with the message.
      timestamp - The time is the epoch milliseconds stored with the message.
      role - The role is a byte from Role.
      type - The type is a byte from FrameType.
      flags - The flags are the short stored on the row.
      rouxId - The identity is the RouxId, or null.
